coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirected to Microsoft Source AI, yielding 11 title links, while the configured feed returned HTTP 410. A separate Source AI tag feed contained 10 dated entries, from September 24 to October 2 at 17:45:11 UTC, including two in the discovery window. These entry points are not interchangeable. Collection-level gaps remain; full-text review of selected items is recorded separately.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured GitHub blog remains an older entry point, with its latest visible date September 23, 2025. Separate official research APIs returned 40 entries each in English and Chinese, with the latest research date September 20, 2026; visible tag results also preceded the window. No window entries appeared in those research lists, but this does not establish complete coverage of all announcements. Bodies were not read as part of these index checks.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The Tongyi Lab page returned HTTP 200 and exposed two news links, without paired titles or publication dates. Three research links to Qwen were not counted again. Direct requests to the news details returned 404. Missing titles and dates prevent complete window coverage and do not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: The API update page, official English and Chinese news pages, Harness product page, and GitHub organization were checked separately. API date strings ran through September 10; news and Harness dates through September 29. The window contained 48 commits in deepseek-harness, but commits are not product announcements. The full API changelog was not read, and ordinary activity in every other repository was not exhaustively inspected. One API page cannot establish institution-wide coverage.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: After an initial SSL failure, official news pages returned HTTP 200. Static timestamps ran through September 10, while the rendered news list ended at March 31; the research index reached September 10 and one opened research entry was dated August 26. AutoClaw blog timestamps changed between requests and were later than the cutoff, so they were excluded. Bigmodel entry points exposed no usable news list. News bodies and all research cards were not reviewed, leaving coverage gaps.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The rendered site showed Step 5 Preview, Step 3.7 Flash, Step 3.5 Flash, and StepAudio 3, without absolute publication dates. The available-today wording and planned October 15 open-weight date were not converted into publication timestamps. The front-end shell and visible product navigation do not establish a complete dated news stream.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: The latest homepage announcement was September 24, before the discovery window. Active venues and open submissions were visible, but submissions were not filtered by date back to the window boundary, and the announcement body was not separately opened. Homepage access does not establish an absence of new submissions across venues.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review AI（试用）: The configured topic page did not produce an article list. Its official topic feed supplied 10 dated entries from September 22 to October 2 at 15:49:04 UTC, including two within the window. The feed does not resolve the configured page's collection gap; abstracts and paywalls were not treated as full text. The selected opinion article's full-text review is recorded separately.
